description: "Pointer to the agentz eval conventions; applies when HVE Core's vally-tests, the validate-plugin skill or anyone writes evals for a plugin under plugins/."
applyTo: "plugins/**"

# agentz eval conventions

The conventions live in the `contributor-conventions` skill of the `onboarding` plugin, so every client reads the same copy: `plugins/onboarding/skills/contributor-conventions/references/evals.md`. Read and follow it before writing or changing evals; its rules override `vally-tests` defaults.
